'''Ownellco''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillian]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was standing near the bar in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], chatting with the [[Qiraash/Legends|Qiraash]] female [[Leesub Sirln/Legends|Leesub Sirln]], on the day that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] chartered [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] for passage to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}.</ref><ref name="RG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Leesub_and_the_Colonel.png|thumb|left|upright|Leesub Sirln chats with Ownellco in Chalmun's Cantina.]]
Ownellco was created as a background character for the cantina scene in [[1977]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], one of two members of his species to appear in the film; the other being [[Atheloe]]. The character was designed by [[John Mollo]],<ref name="SWC ">[[Star Wars Chronicles|''Star Wars: Chronicles'']]</ref> and his mask was sculpted by [[Stuart Freeborn]] for shooting in England.<ref name="CRC">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> The only difference between the two Lutrillian costumes was an ascot worn by one of the actors;<ref name="MOSW ">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> the crew referred to at least one of these characters as the Colonel,<ref name="CRC" /> and at least one as the Hare Mouse.<ref name="SWC " /> [[Lucasfilm]] personnel dubbed one of the characters as Ownellco when [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] asked for official names for the cantina denizens. The article "[[Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases]]" conflates these two Lutrillians as the same, leaving it unclear which Lutrillian was due to be named Ownellco.<ref name="CRC" /> However, "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: The Usual Suspects: Who's Who in Mos Eisley]]" indicates that Ownellco is the one with the ascot.<ref name="RG" />

Ownellco is scantly visible in ''A New Hope'' and receives little screen time. He is visible speaking to the [[Qiraash/Legends|Qiraash]] female [[Leesub Sirln/Legends|Leesub Sirln]]. One of the Lutrillians is later visible walking the streets of Mos Eisley.<ref name="ANH" /> Both of these characters are more prominently featured in a rough cut of the cantina sequence.<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''.</ref>
